GeneDef.label: panoply organ
GeneDef.description: A frame that carries more of itself than it needs and can throw the surplus as real edged blades, flung high enough to come down point first wherever the carrier chose. They stand where they land, can be called at a target all at once, and one can be pulled back into a waiting hand as a plain steel longsword.\n\nEverything that is out is missing: the carrier moves and works like someone holding less of themselves than a person should, until the blades are spent or the body takes them back.
